product_wide_rationale: Governs how one work item reaches a second repository's coordinator session across the store remedy, the installer, and the coordinator instructions, so no single runtime Domain owns host placement.
summary: A second repository's coordinator session is started by the host: the store refuses the cross-repository claim and names the concord_work_start route, the typed session_placement detail answers where the receiving session goes with restore only at the recorded path, and the receiving session resumes with the work_id alone. The session opener, the explicit Project selector, and their consent rules are removed. The installer keeps the tuple entry and its options; the bounded addressed handoff and its consumption are unchanged.
title: Cross-repository coordinator sessions are host-placed
